subject: Novavant pilot runway & approval map — post-call summary
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.ai>
To: Lucille Grant <lucille.grant@novavant.com>, Tom Sato <tom.sato@novavant.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 Jun 2028 15:23:00 -0700
Subject: Novavant pilot runway & approval map — post-call summary

Hi Lucille / Tom — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our call so everyone has the same page and clear next steps.

Key pain & goals (as we heard):
- Cost and latency at scale: you need sub-200ms median latency for user-facing inference and predictable unit economics across 10–20M monthly tokens.
- Data governance: VPC/private deployment options, audit logs, and KMS integration are must-haves for compliance.
- Throughput & burst: typical steady-state ~150–200 req/s with peaks to 350 req/s.
- Success criteria for pilot: 1) integrate with existing infra (SSO + VPC), 2) meet latency SLOs under representative traffic, 3) measure per-token cost delta vs current setup.

Suggested pilot runway (proposed milestones, owners, target dates):
1) Trial access & SOW draft — owner: Rafael (Redwood) / Lucille (Novavant) — target: 2028-06-26
2) Eng kickoff + test dataset delivery — owner: Monica (Redwood) / Tom (Novavant) — target: 2028-07-08
3) Pilot live (dedicated pool, monitoring enabled) — owner: Monica / Novavant infra — target: 2028-07-22
4) Evaluation & procurement decision (security sign-off + contract) — owner: Lucille / Nancy (Legal) / Rafael — target: 2028-08-18

Decision path / stakeholders (as discussed):
- Product sponsor: Lucille Grant (Novavant) — product & business case
- Infra lead: Tom Sato (Novavant) — network/VPC and test data
- Legal / Procurement: Nancy Brown (Novavant) — contract/terms sign-off
- Redwood owners: Rafael (sales), Monica (Customer Success), Aditya (Solutions Eng)

Attachments: discovery notes and a short trial-term summary (see attached stubs).

Asks / next steps:
- Please confirm the stakeholders above and whether Nancy should be looped now or at procurement stage.
- If the dates look feasible, I’ll send a one-page SOW + HubSpot link and book the technical kickoff (30–45m) for the week of 6/26.

If I missed anything, flag it and I’ll update the plan. Thanks — looking forward to moving this to a short pilot.

—
Rafael Mendes
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: novavant-discovery-notes.pdf (summary), redwood-trial-offer-terms.docx (trial terms)

Subject: Re: Novavant pilot runway & approval map — post-call summary

Thanks Rafael — helpful summary. Quick items from our side: 
- Confirming the pain/metrics above are correct.
- Please add our legal contact (Nancy Brown) to the procurement milestone so she can review early; her availability is limited in July.
- We will need SSO + SCIM for user management during the pilot. Can Redwood support that in the trial environment?

Also, Tom asked if you can share a short checklist for our infra team (ports, network egress, cert expectations) before the kickoff.

I can do the kickoff the week of 6/26 but prefer 6/27 AM PT.

– Lucille
Lucille Grant
Head of Product, Novavant
lucille.grant@novavant.com | +1 (617) 444-9910

Subject: Re: Novavant pilot runway & approval map — post-call summary

Appreciate the quick reply, Lucille — I’ve updated the plan below (added Nancy) and attached a short procurement checklist for your infra/legal teams. Answers inline: 

- SSO/SCIM: yes, we support SSO and SCIM for pilot tenants; Monica will own the onboarding config and provide an Auth guide.
- Infra checklist: attached (redwood-procurement-checklist.xlsx) — calls out endpoints, ports, and recommended egress rules.

Updated milestone summary (final draft):
• 2028-06-26 — SOW + trial access provisioned (Rafael / Lucille)
• 2028-07-01 — Legal starts review (Nancy)
• 2028-07-08 — Eng kickoff; Novavant delivers representative test set (+ infra checklist completed) (Monica / Tom)
• 2028-07-22 — Pilot live; telemetry & alerting configured (Monica)
• 2028-08-18 — Pilot evaluation + procurement decision (Lucille / Nancy / Rafael)

Scheduling: I created a HubSpot activity and a tentative kickoff for 2028-06-27 09:30 AM PT per Lucille’s preference. HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/novavant
DocuSign placeholder for SOW: https://docusign.com/link/placeholder/NOV-382

Next steps (for action):
- Novavant: confirm Nancy is the right legal reviewer and confirm that 6/27 09:30 PT works for the tech kickoff.
- Redwood: Monica will schedule the kickoff invite + share the SSO/SCIM onboarding doc and infra checklist. Rafael will circulate the one-page SOW by 6/22.

If that all looks good I’ll convert the HubSpot task to a confirmed meeting and attach the SOW draft for Nancy’s review.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Thanks Rafael — plan looks good. Monica here (CS) — I’ll own the pilot environment and the SSO/SCIM onboarding.

Quick notes from CS side:
- We can provision a dedicated trial pool that mirrors the expected capacity (150–200 req/s) within 48 hours of SOW acceptance.
- For the kickoff please have Novavant share a 1–2GB representative sample (strip PII) and a short list of critical user flows. We’ll provide a data handling template.
- I’ll prepare an initial monitoring dashboard and a short test script to validate latency under load during week 1.

I’ll send the kickoff invite for 2028-06-27 09:30 AM PT and include the onboarding artifacts in the calendar attachment.
